 Viratanagar Kings Lose Second Wicket Against Janakpur Bolts in NPL
 Ratopati
 November 03, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. Viratanagar Kings have lost their second wicket against Janakpur Bolts in the Nepal Premier League (NPL).
 Batting first after losing the toss at the TU Cricket Ground in Kirtipur, Viratanagar lost their second wicket when they scored 109 runs in 13.2 overs.
 Viratanagar's Imran Sheikh was out for 56 runs. He hit 5 fours and 2 sixes in 45 balls. Abhishek Tiwari caught him out by Anil Sah.
 As this news was being prepared, Lokesh Bam was unbeaten on 46 runs. Viratanagar had scored 109 runs for 2 wickets in 13.2 overs.
